# PolyAI moves HQ to Paddington Central

###### News

###### The company will occupy approximately 7,500 sq ft of Work Ready office space.

[social link](https://www.facebook.com/PaddingtonCentral)[social link](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/british-land-workspace/?viewAsMember=true)[social link](https://instagram.com/paddingtoncentral)

News

[PolyAI](https://www.linkedin.com/company/polyai/), a leader in conversational AI software, has chosen [British Land](https://www.linkedin.com/company/british-land/)‘s Paddington Central campus as the location for their new headquarters. The company will occupy c. 7,500 sq ft of Work Ready office space in 3 Sheldon Square.

Work Ready space is designed to support growth and innovation. The spaces are delivered fully fitted, furnished, and connected, enabling teams to move in and begin working immediately. These spaces are tailored to meet the needs of flexible occupiers, offering a seamless transition for businesses.

PolyAI is at the forefront of conversational AI, creating cutting-edge solutions that redefine how businesses engage with their customers. Their new headquarters offers a best-in-class workspace, perfectly suited to support their ongoing innovation and expansion.

![](https://mandc-bl-assets.s3.amazonaws.com/live/paddingtoncentral-2023/2024/11/14122828/20240725_Paddington-Central_3-Sheldon-Square_Reception_021-1-min.jpg)

## 3 Sheldon Square

Right at the heart of Paddington Central, overlooking Sheldon Square and just steps from the canal, 3 Sheldon Square has been recently refurbished by Morris + Co – with new terraces, a new reception that doubles as a workspace, and smart new bike racks, showers and lockers.

[Find out more](https://paddingtoncentral.com/workspace/3-sheldon-square/)
